delivery: conversational, youthful, clear, engaged; preserve English technical terms
hook: Curious, animated and conversational; emphasize the surprise and pause before the question.
body: Warm, engaged storytelling; medium pace, clear contrasts and natural emphasis.
mechanism: Clear and engaged; slightly slow down on technical terms, then resume conversational pace.
caveat: Slightly more serious but engaged; emphasize the limitation without exaggeration.
ending: Warm and satisfied; slightly slower, a clear downward cadence, then a friendly upbeat invitation.
constraints: Do not solve flat delivery only with gain or speed
Do not imitate a real person without authorization
preferred_workflow: Import approved expressive narration or use an explicitly configured TTS provider; audition a new voice before bulk generation.
cost_policy: free_only; never enable billing or buy credits automatically

gemini_style.hook: curious and lightly surprised, conversational, a short pause before the question
gemini_style.body: warm and relaxed storytelling with natural emphasis
gemini_style.mechanism: clear and engaged, slightly slower on technical terms
gemini_style.ending: warm and satisfied, slightly slower, resolved falling cadence

voice_design_persona: A friendly Indonesian young adult narrator, natural conversational Jakarta-neutral accent, curious and warm, clear diction, relaxed pace. An original persona; not an imitation of any real person.
request_budget: One provider request per episode (single take, then split). Never loop retries on a quota error. A fallback provider takes over a WHOLE episode, never half of one.
